description: Develop 1978–1985 arcade concepts and finish playable games with rounds, scoring, pixel assets, and era-authentic procedural audio.

codex.shortDescription: Finish arcade games with rounds, pixels, and retro sound.
defaultPrompts: Propose three original fixed-screen arcade concepts.
Add rounds and a high-score loop to this playable game.
Build a coherent retro sound kit for this game.

requirements: Pixel asset generation needs an image-generation tool, Node.js, and ImageMagick convert.
Audio integration needs a runnable game and a host audio implementation; this package does not supply recorded music.
